verdict.rationale: Alma's own pages cover most of the founder visa menu: O-1A and O-1B, including founder self-sponsorship and agent petitioners; H-1B; E-2; TN; the green-card paths EB-1 and EB-2 NIW; and even International Entrepreneur Rule parole. For choosing a path, it offers a ranked recommendation view (O-1A recommended, EB-1A strong, H-1B cap-subject as backup), a founder visa-options guide and O-1-to-green-card sequencing advice. Missing for 10: any coverage of cap-exempt H-1B routes (only cap-subject H-1B appears), substantive E-2 and TN guidance beyond one-line definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the choosing guidance.
